column1: # Taskr #205 - provision-member round trip measured from a phone, 2026-09-07.
# Device      Samsung SM-S918U, Android 16, curl 8.15.0 under `adb shell`. No browser.
# Function    provision-member, deployment v8, ezbr_sha256
#             c7c2e6f4f2afafe5ce05c1948ece9f3fd517228fcbbec26b5e9826ba7f0efd73,
#             deployed 2026-09-04T22:31:12.914Z; source last moved by commit dbe6bbd.
# Analysis    docs/hosting-decision.md, section "Measured 2026-09-07".
# Every row is a REFUSAL. auth=key sends the publishable key and reaches the
# function (401 {"error":"Sign in first."}); auth=none sends no Authorization
# header and is refused by the GATEWAY one hop short of it
# (401 {"code":"UNAUTHORIZED_NO_AUTH_HEADER"}), so it times the network without
# booting anything. `reached` is classified from the body that came back, not
# from which call was intended. No write, no credential minted, no provider call.
# The per-pass public egress addresses are REDACTED: they are the owner's home
# and cellular IPs and this repo is public. They were recorded at capture time
# and differed between the wifi and cellular passes, which is the control that
# the two networks really are two networks.
# Times are seconds as curl reports them. idle_s is the idle ACTUALLY SLEPT
# before a cold window, 0 where it does not apply.
# pass  1,2 = warm (wireless debugging); 3 = cold schedule, six 930 s idle
#             windows over USB, detached on the phone.
# phase warm | first-after-idle | reused | control | cold | warm-after-cold
